patch_description: The current lattice gives sum 2.37 but leaves wasted space near corners and between staggered rows. Instead of a single fixed grow pass, alternate (a) fully vectorized radius growth to the true feasibility limit for current centers, and (b) a center-relaxation step that pushes each circle away from its most binding constraint (wall or neighbor), with a decaying step size plus tiny deterministic jitter. Keeping the best valid configuration found gives a monotone improvement over the current constructor while remaining a short refinement of an explicit layout, pushing the sum toward the 2.635 target.
